feed_conditions.note: Table 1 reuses critical flux from reference [8]; do not assume separately measured pressure loss shares all feed conditions. Garcia Fig. 4 concentration sweep is at pH 7.0, not automatically Table 1.

garcia2008_table1.energy_boundary: Axial hydraulic dissipation per permeate volume AT EACH ROW critical flux. No pump efficiency, transmembrane pressure work, cooling, cleaning or capital costs included.
garcia2008_table1.flow_basis: Table column Q unit L/h as supplied; per-channel versus full-bundle basis unresolved. Q is volumetric flow despite prose calling it flow velocity.

protocol.critical_flux_definition: Average of last time-independent and first time-dependent flux step
protocol.repeatability: Repeated several times; averages reported; numerical critical-flux error bars unavailable; clean-water-flux change <1% is not critical-flux uncertainty.

chiu2005_fig3.bound_scope: Independent marker/tick-centre sensitivity chosen for the reading; not experimental uncertainty or a confidence interval.

conditions.feed: Effluent of synthetic activated-sludge production system; not raw porous-pot feed recipe.

reported_reproducibility.interpretation: Authors state errors never exceed 5% for critical flux/rejection; not identified as standard deviation, confidence interval or point-specific uncertainty.

chiu2006_module.transfer_limit: Same nominal star-channel family as Garcia 2008, not an asserted identical specimen; Dh used only in a conditional geometry consistency audit.

chiu2006_feed.source_location: Table 2; effluent used for membrane filtration
chiu2006_feed.range_interpretation: Reported operating-period ranges, not standard deviations or uncertainties on individual figure points.
chiu2006_feed.do_not_use_as_filtration_feed: Table 1 is the upstream porous-pot feed recipe, not the treated effluent composition.

frederic2018_model.kind: Theoretical numerical comparison, not experimental fouling calibration
frederic2018_model.spatial_domain: 2D porous-membrane cross-section; channel wall pressure versus external permeate pressure; symmetry boundaries
frederic2018_model.axial_validity: Whole-module interpretation requires axial pressure loss negligible relative to TMP; otherwise represents a local axial slice.
frederic2018_model.selective_resistance_m_inv: e_m/K_m; preserve impedance when numerically thickening the selective region
frederic2018_model.fouling_law_as_supplied: dRc/dt = -A*(u dot n); A chosen arbitrarily; no local crossflow-velocity dependence
frederic2018_model.equation_audit: Supplied Markdown Eqs. 4 and 8 imply A=B1*B2, while following Eq. 9 prose states B2/B1. Preserve this discrepancy; check source typography before implementing. Do not silently transplant the coefficient.
frederic2018_model.reported_figures_role: Geometry, pressure/flux distribution and normalized fouling trends; not a measured Jcrit(u) relation.

scenario_scope: Nominal table comparison at the existing project target. No operating margin, new steady-state process, suspension properties or slurry DWSIM validation inferred.
unresolved_issues: Garcia Table 1 Q/u corresponds to roughly single-channel scale rather than the stated full seven-channel module; no factor correction accepted.
Chiu 2005 Fig. 3 borrowed critical-flux series differs in some velocity locations and one flux from Garcia Table 1; retain separate readings.
Garcia filtration viscosity/temperature and point-specific uncertainty unavailable; rheometer values are not substituted.
Original PDFs for these four sources absent; Markdown tables/equation typography can be audited later without requiring raw data or new experiments.
